question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 D 组：澳大利亚 vs 土耳其，90 分钟赛果？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group D: Australia vs Türkiye — 90-minute result?
one_liner_cn: 土耳其 Elo 高出 134 分、主力齐整且近 8 场 7 胜 1 平，明显占优；澳大利亚锋线减员、主力中卫长伤初愈，土耳其胜约 53.5%。
one_liner_en: Türkiye hold a 134-point Elo edge with a full-strength, in-form squad (7W1D in last 8), while Australia are down a forward and a key defender is fresh off a long injury — Türkiye win around 53.5%.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 134 分（土耳其 1911 vs 澳大利亚 1777），Davidson 三路模型在中立场地给土耳其约 51.6% 基础胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 134-point Elo gap (Türkiye 1911 vs Australia 1777) gives Türkiye ~51.6% baseline win probability in the Davidson three-way model at a neutral venue.

key_reasons.cn: 土耳其 26 人名单主力齐整（Çalhanoğlu、Güler、Yıldız、Aktürkoğlu 均入选），且近 8 场 7 胜 1 平状态出色。
key_reasons.en: Türkiye's 26-man squad is at full strength (Çalhanoğlu, Güler, Yıldız, Aktürkoğlu all named) and arrives in strong form with 7W1D in their last 8.

key_reasons.cn: 澳大利亚前锋 D'Agostino 备战营伤退，主力中卫 Souttar 跟腱重伤缺阵近 500 天后刚复出，状态存疑。
key_reasons.en: Australia lost striker D'Agostino to injury in pre-camp, and first-choice centre-back Souttar has only just returned after nearly 500 days out with an Achilles injury.

method_note: Market-blind: eloratings.net Elo -> Davidson three-way model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) baseline 23.9/24.6/51.6, then bounded evidence adjustment (~2pp toward Türkiye, cap ±8pp) and renormalization. 80% intervals reflect drawNu 0.6-0.8 sensitivity plus evidence thinness. No betting/prediction-market data consulted.
